headline: Retail inflation rate reaches 8-month high of 4.82 in August, rising food prices show effect - india's retail inflation hits 8-month high of 4.82 in august
summary: India's retail inflation rose to 4.82% in August, the highest in eight months. Rising food and beverage prices added pressure on household budgets and kept inflation above the RBI's target.
why: Retail inflation is the main gauge the Reserve Bank of India uses in setting interest rates, so it influences borrowing costs and rupee-denominated assets.
